cur:manuscripts-rossano-healing-blind.summary: Followed by two disciples, Christ in a gold mantle touches the eyes of the blind man, who then appears again on the right bending over a fountain basin to wash, as onlookers watch. The two moments of the miracle — the anointing and the washing in the pool of Siloam — are told side by side. Prophets below point to the light given to the blind.
facts: Continuous narrative, with the same figure appearing twice in one strip, is used throughout the Rossano miniatures.
The Rossano Gospels contains the Gospel of Matthew and most of Mark; a companion volume with Luke and John is thought to have been lost.

cur:manuscripts-valcavado-lamb-on-mount-.summary: Above, the four living creatures and the elders appear among great wheels in the heavens; in the middle register the Lamb with a cross-staff stands on Mount Sion, drawn as a tall mound of scales, while the redeemed play their harps on either side, singing a new song.
facts: The Valcavado Beatus was written and illuminated in 970 by the monk Oveco for Abbot Sempronius of Valcavado, in the reign of Ramiro III of León; it has 230 surviving leaves and 87 miniatures.
After the expulsion of the Jesuits under Charles III, the manuscript passed from their college of San Ambrosio in Valladolid to the University of Valladolid.
cur:manuscripts-valcavado-lamb-on-mount-.notes: Christ is represented as the Lamb.

rijks:BK-18897.summary: This small bronze figure of Christ, once fixed to a cross, holds his arms stretched straight out with open hands, his head turned slightly to one side and his feet resting on a footrest. A long loincloth falls in symmetrical folds, leaving the knees free. Worn smooth by age and handling, it is a typical Romanesque crucifix figure, presenting Christ calm and upright even in death.
facts: The Rijksmuseum notes that the figure was cast in one piece and is hollow at the back, and that the hands and feet are pierced for attachment to a cross.
It is so worn that the mouth is barely visible and the beard has disappeared entirely.
It is about 18.8 cm high and 17.8 cm wide.
